title: Interphase amendment 2 hand-off: meadow-snapshot-pacing amend-2 handed to mitosis under interphase 0.8.1
context: Spec review 5 of amendment 2, the last under the convergence rule (decision 01M4VCYDXP9GR5WSDHH0F5G2DR), reported 3 issues. 1: 10.15 did not say the phone rests after the app launch, which itself raised the throttle level to 2 in each of the six r5 launches. 2: the 10.3 row did not catch a pacer that carries batches behind a marker past 30 frame intervals; a probe of the extended row (batch F at 516,677 us must call the marker) passes on the scratch oneflight pacer and fails on that flawed pacer at the F check. 3: f-note10-throttle's counts were stale (now 25 of 85 at level 2). All three change what is built or measured or are mechanical, so all were fixed. check_record --complete, both renders, check_spec, check_items and check_items --amendment pass under 0.8.1. The tree guard first flagged the interphase probe worktree and the wt-mac worktree from the owner's Mac test build; both were removed, the Field Notes Fix app keeps running from its copy in the kit, and the guard then verified clean. The guard was deleted and the record set handed-off.
options: Hand off now with review 5's three fixes, without a sixth review
Dispatch a sixth spec review of the three fixes before hand-off
option_reasons: The convergence rule makes review 5 the last; each fix is either verified by probe (the 10.3 row passes on the correct pacer and fails on the flawed one) or a wording/count correction checked by the scripts, and build review round 3 is the next independent check
Would break the owner's convergence rule, and 0.8.1 has no follow-up-review requirement
outcome: Handed off. Amendment 2 adds Step pacer-one-marker-between-frames (MSP meadow-snapshot-pacing-amend-2) in docs/specs/meadow-snapshot-pacing.amend-2.items.json. Next: copy it to ~/.mitosis/field-notes/meadow-snapshot-pacing/amend-2.items.json, run amend-2.zsh --plan-only, then the build, merge into mitosis/meadow-snapshot-pacing, and review round 3 with previous_head 0289cbbf. Top risks for the final report: 10.12 to 10.15 unproven by the builder (device measured); the overrides of meadow-opening-recolour-stutter decisions lines 16, 20 and 21; review 5's fixes had no sixth review; the 24.4 fps two-stage replay's cause is unknown (1 of 26); the mid-run move from interphase 0.8.0 to 0.8.1 dropped the record's review history (kept at review/spec-reviews-amend-2.json); and the owner's go-ahead past the review-3 no-progress stop.
